title: The Taxonomy of the Unwashed Coffee Mug
core_theme: The small domestic chore as a proxy for emotional resentment.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct a ceramic mug left sitting in a dry kitchen sink for three consecutive days, bearing a dark ring of oxidized residue. Treat the object with clinical precision, mapping how a minor discrepancy in cleanliness becomes an active battlefield or a silent monument to unexpressed relational friction. The poem must capture the precise weight of the silence that fills the kitchen when both parties look at the sink but say nothing.

title: Litany for the Early Morning Grocery List
core_theme: The mundane choreography of shared survival logistics.
narrative_spec: Describe the pain of forgetfulness on mundane things. Just go with it.

title: The Epistemology of the Leftover Takeout
core_theme: The micro-measurement of culinary ownership and fairness.
narrative_spec: Where do you experience the polotics of existing?

title: The Blueprint of the Common Cold Isolation
core_theme: The primitive, unglamorous administration of domestic care.
narrative_spec: Document one partner nursing the other through a messy, unromantic winter illness. The fear of vulnerability.

title: The Dialectics of the Passenger Seat Silence
core_theme: The suffocating velocity of a long-distance drive argument.
narrative_spec: A couple sits in the enclosed cabin of a car traveling down a highway at seventy miles per hour after a disagreement. Where might the true conflict lie?

title: The Calibration of the Living Room Thermostat
core_theme: The biological negotiation of ambient comfort zones.
narrative_spec: How has conflict become a language?

title: The Sinking Index of the Unreturned Key
core_theme: The legal and emotional friction of a lingering asset.
narrative_spec: Can you embody the fear of abandonment through the eyes of someone insecure?

title: The Liturgy of the Midnight Emergency Run
core_theme: The sudden mobilization of protection against a household crisis.
narrative_spec: Capture the frenetic energy of modern day first world tragedy. Bonus points if you tie in religious themes.

title: The Taxonomy of the Laundry Basket Sort
core_theme: The intimate, sensory interweaving of physical residues.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the physical act of sorting a combined pile of dirty clothing into darks and lights. Focus on the literal intertangling of sleeves, the matching scent of laundry detergent and human sweat, and the casual vulnerability of handling another person's undergarments. Reframe the chore as a visceral, textile proof of an unescapable shared life.

title: The Protocol of the Muted Television Screen
core_theme: The parallel, uncommunicative consumption of empty space.
narrative_spec: I want to understand the focus and attraction of a connected physical experience, in the absence of dialogue

title: The Interrogation of the Shared Bank Statement
core_theme: The material boundaries of collective trust and individual desire.
narrative_spec: Turn the mundane into erotic frenetic energy. Make life sexy.

title: The Baseline Hiss of the White-Noise Machine
core_theme: The acoustic engineering required for psychological peace.
narrative_spec: Focus on a small electronic device emitting a steady hum on a nightstand to drown out the city streets or a partner's uneven breathing patterns. Reframe the synthetic sound as an active insulation barrier, a microscopic acoustic wall erected between two minds sleeping inches apart, highlighting the profound effort required to share a single room safely.

title: The Metric of the Unspoken Apology Biscuit
narrative_spec: Detail a moment of unequivocal love, care, or honor. Make me desire.

title: The Architecture of the Half-Assembled Frame
core_theme: The test of cooperative logic against spatial frustration.
narrative_spec: A couple attempts to hang a massive, heavy mirror or assemble a complicated piece of furniture together in a narrow hallway.

title: The Taxonomy of the Broken Dish
core_theme: The sudden, material punctuation of an domestic rift.
narrative_spec: explain how an animal companion fits the scope of human domestication.

title: The Sovereignty of the Late-Night Porch Decompression
core_theme: The necessity of the individual lung within a shared space.

title: The Foundation of the Inherited Furniture Clutter
core_theme: The material collision of past family histories in a modern space.
narrative_spec: Look at the love around you, make it painfully simple in a poem.

title: The Geometry of the Morning Departure Kiss
core_theme: The perfunctory execution of habitual affection.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the split-second, decision to speak your mind, regret or glory?
